body_markdown:
Kat leads Community and Engagement at Watsi. Her passion has always been bringing people together around a good cause and helping good ideas come to life.


Throughout her career, Kat has been a communications and event expert in nonprofit and government sectors across Europe, sub-Saharan Africa, Asia, North America, and Central America. Her work has taken her from community-based programs to international development and government initiatives, always with a focus on transforming hope into real action.


Today, Kat lives in West Africa with her family. When she’s not working, she is usually chasing after her two boys and her border collie. She loves to travel, catch up with friends, and belongs to a book club, where she enjoys the conversation as much as the books themselves.
